notes: OCPA stores zoning as JURISDICTION-DISTRICT/overlays, e.g. ORL-R-3B/T/AN. Matching uses the jurisdiction prefix plus the base district (before overlay suffixes). Edit this file to change what counts as multifamily-capable; do not hard-code a second list in the app. PD/PUD is always maybe — site-specific. Conditional districts (Live Local commercial/industrial, some mixed-use overlays) are off by default and gated by the conditional toggle. Rutherford County, TN prefixes (MUR, SMY, LVG, EAG, RUT) are included for the Nashville market. Only districts the county card calls multifamily-relevant are scored; other Rutherford districts stay unscored.

jurisdictions.name: Orange County (unincorporated)
jurisdictions.coverageNote: Use table Sec. 38-77 and district divisions in Ch. 38 reviewed for 4+ multifamily. Horizon West form-based districts (NR/NC/NAC) are included from the same table.

districts.label: Multiple-Family Dwelling
districts.why: Ch. 38 Div. 10 R-3 Multiple-Family Dwelling District; Sec. 38-77 lists “Multifamily w/ customary accessory uses” as P. Four or more units: 15,000 sq ft min (Sec. 38-1501). Restricted GIS label RSTD R-3 is treated as R-3 with overlay limits — confirm the restriction.

districts.label: University Residential
districts.why: Ch. 38 Div. 11 UR-3 University Residential. Sec. 38-77 multifamily is P. Site standards for four or more dwelling units in Sec. 38-1501.

districts.label: Residential District (includes multifamily in the use table)
districts.why: Non-obvious: Sec. 38-77 lists multifamily as a permitted use (P) in R-2, not only R-3. R-2 is also a consistent zoning district for MDR/MHDR/HDR on the county FLU/zoning correlation table. Confirm height/special-exception rules (one-story vs. taller near single-family).

districts.label: Residential Low-Density
districts.why: Sec. 38-77 shows multifamily as 124 P in R-L-D (permitted with conditions 1 and 24). Condition 24 ties multifamily to F.S. § 125.01055 (Live Local Act). Not a by-right garden-apartment district.

districts.label: Neighborhood Residential (form-based)
districts.why: Sec. 38-77 lists multifamily as P in NR. Paired with NR FLU (20 du/ac).

districts.label: Neighborhood Center (form-based)
districts.why: Sec. 38-77 lists multifamily as 24 P in NC (Live Local / condition 24). NC FLU allows 40 du/ac. Treated as conditional, not by-right R-3 equivalent.

districts.label: Neighborhood Activity Corridor
districts.why: Sec. 38-77 lists multifamily as 24 P in NAC. NAC FLU allows 25 du/ac.

districts.label: Retail Commercial (Live Local path)
districts.why: Sec. 38-77 marks multifamily 24 P in C-1. Sec. 38-79(24) requires compliance with F.S. § 125.01055 (Live Local Act) — not a conventional by-right apartment district. Turn on “include conditional zoning” to see these sites.

districts.label: General Commercial (Live Local path)
districts.why: Sec. 38-77: multifamily 24 P in C-2, subject to Sec. 38-79(24) / Live Local Act.

districts.label: Wholesale Commercial (Live Local path)
districts.why: Sec. 38-77: multifamily 24 P in C-3, subject to Sec. 38-79(24) / Live Local Act.

districts.label: Restricted Industrial (Live Local path)
districts.why: Sec. 38-77: multifamily 24 P in I-1A and I-1/I-5. Industrial flex / Live Local — not by-right MF. OCPA sometimes labels these IND-*.

districts.label: Industrial park (OCPA label for I-2/I-3)
districts.why: OCPA GIS uses IND-2/IND-3 for Ch. 38 I-2/I-3. Sec. 38-77: multifamily 24 P. Conditional / Live Local, not conventional MF zoning.

districts.label: Industrial (OCPA label for I-4)
districts.why: Sec. 38-77: multifamily 24 P in I-4, subject to condition 24 / Live Local.

districts.label: Mixed-use (OCPA GIS label)
districts.why: Appears on some unincorporated OCPA extracts. Not a Ch. 38 base district name. Treat as mixed-use capable of residential only after confirming the ordinance or PD; not invented as a loophole.

districts.label: Residential multifamily (legacy GIS code)
districts.why: Legacy OCPA multifamily label when present. Confirm against current Ch. 38 mapping.

districts.label: Multifamily development district R-3B

districts.label: Multifamily development district R-3C
districts.why: Ch. 58 Part 2E R-3C development district.

districts.label: Multifamily development district R-3D
districts.why: Ch. 58 Part 2E R-3D development district.

districts.why: Ch. 58 mixed-development districts; allowable-use table includes residential / multiplex in MXD-1.

districts.label: Mixed-use development 2
districts.why: Ch. 58 mixed-development districts; allowable-use table includes residential / multiplex in MXD-2.

districts.label: Neighborhood Activity Center
districts.why: Ch. 58 Part 2O: AC-N is for concentrated neighborhood-serving commercial, office, residential, recreational and cultural facilities. Mixed use including residential is encouraged.

districts.label: Community Activity Center
districts.why: Ch. 58 Part 2O AC-1 Community Activity Center — mixed use including residential at community scale.

districts.label: Urban Activity Center
districts.why: Ch. 58 Part 2O AC-2 intended for concentrated residential, commercial, office, industrial, recreational and cultural facilities at urban intensity.

districts.label: Metropolitan Activity Center
districts.why: Ch. 58 Part 2O AC-3 metropolitan mixed use including residential at the highest intensities outside downtown. Mixture of land uses is specifically intended.

districts.label: Metropolitan Activity Center 3A
districts.why: Activity-center subdistrict used with AC-3; high-density residential as part of mixed use.

districts.label: Mixed use 1
districts.why: Listed on Orlando Fig. 2A.LDC allowable-use table with residential categories. Confirm the current table footnote for 4+ apartments vs. multiplex.

districts.label: Mixed use 2
districts.why: Listed on Orlando Fig. 2A.LDC allowable-use table with residential categories.

districts.label: Office 1 (multiplex 3–8, not large apartments)
districts.why: Ch. 58 Part 3H multiplex (3–8 dwelling units) applies in O-1. This is small-scale multiplex, not a by-right 4+ apartment campus. Included only when conditional zoning is on.

districts.label: Office 2 (multiplex 3–8, not large apartments)
districts.why: Ch. 58 Part 3H multiplex (3–8 dwelling units) applies in O-2. Conditional / limited residential, not AC-scale MF.

districts.why: Non-obvious: C-C purpose allows multi-family dwellings above ground-level commercial and office. Not a standalone RMF district.

districts.label: Regional Commercial (includes standalone MF)

districts.label: Corridor Commercial

districts.label: Downtown Mixed-Use
districts.why: MU-D downtown purpose lists multi-family and townhome dwellings among allowed uses.

districts.label: Mixed-Use East Shore Gateway
districts.why: MU-ES-GT purpose expressly permits a range of uses including multi-family.

districts.label: Mixed-Use East Shore Research/Tech/Education
districts.why: Industrial-flex mixed district: purpose states multifamily and townhomes are allowed alongside light industrial / office / R&D. Confirm Article 4 use table for 4+ apartments.

districts.label: Mixed-Use East Shore New Market
districts.why: Village-center subdistrict supporting a mix of retail, office, and residential.

districts.label: Mixed-use (OCPA GIS label)
districts.why: OCPA MIXED / MIXED-EC labels in Apopka. MIXED-EC is not a named Article 3 district; do not assume employment-center mixed equals apartments. Confirm the official zoning map.

districts.label: Legacy R-3 (if still mapped in OCPA)
districts.why: Older OCPA extracts used R-3 for Apopka multifamily. Current LDC uses RMF. Keep the token so legacy GIS codes still match.

jurisdictions.coverageNote: Table 5-1 permitted uses: Dwelling, Multi-family is P only in R-3. Mixed-use is a special exception in several commercial districts via PUD — not treated as by-right MF.

districts.why: Sec. 58-68 Multifamily (high density R-4). Intended for multifamily but may not be newly assigned to lots that were not R-4 before January 1, 2007. Density caps have been amended downward — confirm the current section.
